title: Each type at airport security
caption:
Same queue, sixteen completely different experiences.

One person bagged their liquids at home. One is reorganising the line. One is explaining to security why the giant jar of homemade jam is a gift. Swipe to find yourself, and the person you always travel with.

Send this to your travel buddy before your next trip.
